messages:
ida: Hey team — I'm hosting three external folks tomorrow at 11am. One courier said they'll drop a bulky package (might be a folding chair set) around 9am. Can front desk accept and where should they stash it?

marco: Front desk can take it. If it's stackable, locker #4 or the rack behind the mailroom works. Ask courier to label with your name + meeting time.

toni: If it's heavy, mailroom prefers we log it and use the dolly. Otherwise locker #4 is fine.

ida: Cool. Courier number is +1-555-0199. I'll ask them to mark: "IDA - 11am meeting" and to photo on arrival.

locker-bot: Incoming delivery recorded: carrier=LocalHaul, ETA=tomorrow 08:55, size=box (possible chairs), recipient=Ida. Suggested hold: locker #4. Photo-on-arrival requested.

rebecca: Seating Q: Do you want the casual couch area (cozy) or the high-top bench (monitor + power)? React with :one: for couch, :two: for bench.

ida: :two: bench please need monitors and power for a quick demo.

marco: I'll reserve bench 3 and move a spare monitor over. If courier arrives early i'll put the package in locker #4 and ping you.

frontdesk-bot: Note: temp badges print with purple stripe. Pre-registering guests by 10:00am will speed check-in. Walk-ins allowed but may wait.

toni: Also heads-up if guests want to take the chair set home, we require a sign-out form at the mailroom.

ida: Got it, will tell courier to label and will DM guest names to Marco. Thanks y'all! :raised_hands:
